##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 03 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slack low pressure centred over England moves eastwards, as high pressure in the mid-Atlantic builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

North or Northeast 2 to 4, backing mainly North or Northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 tomorrow afternoon, but remaining Variable 3 or less in places throughout the period.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, but Variable 3 or less in the west of the area at first, veering East 4 or 5 occasionally 6 Tuesday evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
